Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: 1536x1024 transparent PNG asset sheet for independent website motion elements
Primary request: Six isolated photorealistic designer desk stationery objects, top-down product photography, arranged evenly in exactly a three-column two-row grid. Each object must be entirely within its own 512x512 cell with generous transparent padding and no touching.
Subjects: top left cobalt-blue handled open metal scissors at a slight angle; top center pink manila folder with one white paper peeking out and a small orange circular sticker; top right a red sharpened wooden pencil on a diagonal; bottom left a silver and black binder clip; bottom center a crumpled cream paper ball; bottom right a pair of folded tortoiseshell eyeglasses viewed top-down.
Materials: authentic tactile paper, polished metal and plastic, realistic product photography.
Lighting: subtle soft product shadows localized directly around each object.
Constraints: transparent background with genuine alpha, each object isolated, no background, no grid lines, no words, no watermark. Six distinct objects only, arranged exactly as specified, generous padding around every object.

Style: minimalist French fashion campaign, photorealistic luxury editorial still life, authentic supple burgundy leather texture and reflective silver.
Composition: landscape, product large at center-right with generous negative space around it.
Lighting: direct flash with a soft shadow.
Constraints: no text, no logo, no watermark, no interface, no additional objects.
